getModelFits.Rd

Get Model Fits

Usage

getModelFits(
  models,
  y = NULL,
  newdata = NULL,
  cores = getOption("mc.cores", 4)
)

Arguments

models

list of models fitted by constrSelEst function

y

response variable

newdata

data.frame containing all variables that appear in the model formula

cores

number of cores to use, compare loo
